S01: Tessa's fallback

Scores: emotion/story 2, understood with sound off 2, pacing 2, composition/legibility 3

1. At 3.54 s, one bundle sits by the door with no price over it, even though "$120 a month" was spoken from 1.8 to 3.2 s. The price label doesn't show until 8.26 s, about 5 s late. Fix: drop the first bundle on "one" at 1.8 s and put "$120/mo" over it on "month" at 3.2 s.
2. From 8.26 to 10.62 s the frame doesn't change. The stack never grows, and this is the core idea of the scene. Fix: add one bundle on each beat ("borrowing" 4.5, "thousand" 6.2, "city" 8.3, "biggest" 9.8) so the stack climbs toward the roofline.
3. At 5.9 s the camera pulls back and the bundle slides about 100 px away from the house. It reads as an object left behind, not something tied to Tessa. Fix: keep the stack touching the house wall and keep the 1.18 s framing. The house is now small in a mostly empty dark frame.
4. At 10.62 s, "biggest bill" refers to the mortgage payment, but the only thing on screen is the $120 stack, so viewers may read $120 as her biggest bill. Fix: on "payment" at 8.9 s, show a large slab for the mortgage payment next to the thin $120 stack.

S06: The 15-year finish

Scores: emotion/story 3, understood with sound off 4, pacing 3, composition/legibility 3

1. At 2.7 s the green "fallback" ghost bar and its label are almost black on black and can't be read. The bars also have no labels. Fix: raise the brightness of the ghost bar and show the 15-year and 30-year labels from the start.
2. At 13.48 s the house and Tessa disappear, the bars jump left, and the "$2,948" line ends up next to the ILLUSTRATIVE badge. By 18.88 s everything snaps back. This is a framing pop with no reason behind it. Fix: hold the 8.09 s framing for the whole scene.
3. At 18.88 s only the first bill is falling, but "month after month" has been implied since 9.3 s. The stack then appears almost all at once before 24.27 s. Fix: start peeling bills off the sliver at "more" (12.2 s) and drop them at a steady rate so the stack grows the whole way to 24.9 s.
4. At 8.09 s the gold sliver is only a few pixels tall. Fix: push in on the bar tops from 9.3 to 12.2 s so the gap fills the frame, then pull back for the stack.
